findings.text: the crew admit help states the pass bound as a hardcoded phrase ("each under a five-second deadline") rather than reading LANE_GATE_READ_DEADLINE_SECONDS (reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:1166, the constant the pass's lane and fleet gate reads actually pass to _read_text_under_deadline), and the help test asserts the literal substring "five-second" (tests/test_a_manual_admission_pass_reports_its_verdicts.py:284), so a change to the deadline constant leaves the help misstating the bound while the test stays green.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against a3395779221d2f5cbfd88c1becdfe049453c3330: 038da9f3d adds _pass_verdict_record, _publish_pass_verdicts and the publish call in the loop and rewrites the admit help; 5b06d60ce adds the landing fragment; both stay inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_a_manual_admission_pass_reports_its_verdicts.py over two passes of two queued runs (one admitted, one scope-refused), --once unchanged, and the help naming the loop, the single pass and the pass bound, gated with three further suites; the manifest records the four-suite run (33 passed, EXIT=0) in gate-head.log and the declared negative control (1 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1) in negative-control.log, both on disk.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that the bare crew admit loop print each pass's verdicts as one JSON line; at head reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:1389 calls _publish_pass_verdicts(_record_pass_verdicts(admit_once(...))) inside the loop of admit_until_stopped, and :954 prints json.dumps(record), flush=True, while the once branch at :1381 records without publishing.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 038da9f3d and 5b06d60ce, gate-head.log and negative-control.log named with their figures, the two retry_failures attributed as scaffolding, and the landing line present; it carries no baseline_suite/after_suite arms, which the reviewed node's done-when did not declare (it substituted the declared mutation for a base checkout its worktree rules forbid).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew_run_commands.py, reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, tests/test_a_manual_admission_pass_reports_its_verdicts.py, the landing fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/a-coordinator-can-clear-its-own-duties/ and a docs/figures/ directory; git diff a3395779221d2f5cbfd88c1becdfe049453c3330..5b06d60ce56f808d962cb1fcc5da3a4588892843 changes exactly the first four and writes no figure.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_manual_admission_pass_reports_its_verdicts.py:221 and :229 fail when the loop stops publishing -- the declared negative control reddens exactly that assertion with 0 printed against 2 required -- but the help case at :284 asserts a literal word, not the deadline constant it describes.
justifications.evidence: the gate genuinely ran the four suites the done-when names (33 passed, EXIT=0, gate-head.log:5-8) with a recorded negative control (negative-control.log:54-56), but the reviewed run declares no base arm and the help's pass bound is a literal (reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3548) that cannot fail on drift.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:923 and :944 follow the module's private-helper style beside _record_pass_verdicts at :957, and every added name (_pass_verdict_record, _publish_pass_verdicts) states what it does with no plan, stage or ticket reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:1389 publishes each pass's record from the loop and :954 prints it as one JSON line, which is the goal's one-sentence deliverable.
justifications.reuse: no owner exists for a per-pass stdout publisher: the search over reckon/crew and the CLI commands found only _emit_crew_result (reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:292), which emits a single result with a pretty option rather than streaming one line per pass, and _pass_verdict_record consolidates the dictionary that _record_pass_verdicts built inline, so both additions extend the owner rather than forking one.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff a3395779221d2f5cbfd88c1becdfe049453c3330..5b06d60ce56f808d962cb1fcc5da3a4588892843 is one of the manifest's declared write paths, and the declared figures directory is left unwritten as the done-when implies.
